featured_techniques.technique: External perception as a pathway to improvement
Fork-in-the-road decision points emphasizing customer and employee focus

sections.description: Overview of using a five-step path to compare company decisions with those of beloved brands, highlighting the aim to achieve devoted customers and growth while revealing how you are seen externally and how decisions can be oriented toward customers and employees.
sections.title: Introduction to the Five-Decision Path

summary: Jeanne Bliss introduces a five-step decision assessment that asks viewers to benchmark their company decisions against five decisions made by beloved brands. The aim is to reveal how externally perceived decisions influence loyalty, growth, and overall brand image, and to show how such decisions can be oriented toward both customers and employees. The talk emphasizes that at each decision point (the “fork in the road”) observers will see how beloved companies guide their choices and how those decisions are operationally executed within the organization to drive devoted customers and sustainable growth.
title: Introduction to the Five-Decision Path for Customer-Centric Growth
